title: 第17章 天守阁第18章 馊主意
content_zh:
我是该实话实说，还是用言语套路一下眼前这个小姑娘，挖出更多情报来？
稍微权衡了几秒后，赵晨就决定选择前者，毕竟此地危机四伏，万一自己的话术误导了明显更有经验的小姑娘，很可能招致更大的灾祸，让任务失败。
赵晨虽然热衷于冒险，却也并非不爱惜自己生命的莽夫，自然明白当前环境下只有和小姑娘精诚合作才更有利于解决问题。
而开诚布公是合作的前提。
“当然，更主要的是，这姑娘在询问我情报前，先主动将她所掌握的信息告知，为人处事显然很大气，我如果套路她、诓骗她，一旦被识破，必然会令她不喜……
“对这样的性格，最好还是示之以诚。
“啧，身为半个‘旅行商人’，‘见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话’，也是必备素养嘛。”
思绪电转间，赵晨简单将自己看到“观音图”
，然后莫名被送入这里的过程讲了讲，但没有提及“大日星槎”
，只说利用某种手段看了妖道方虚子的记忆。
末了，他摊摊手道：“所以，我也不知道自己在这个场景里是什么身份。”
“原来你是这么进来的……”
俏丽少女若有所思地点了点头，似乎还想点问点什么，但很快，她的语气就又切换到了略显急躁的状态，“算了，等活着出去再说吧，这次的任务可能很麻烦。
“我姓祁，具体名字不告诉你，公子你怎么称呼？”
说话很连贯，思维逻辑也没有明显断层，只是说话时随着情绪会变成不同风格，倒不太像是两个人格……不过具体什么情况，我也说不好……
心里思索的同时，赵晨口中也回应道：“我姓赵，排行第二，叫我赵二……郎就好了。”
“赵二”
听着太像个龙套，也不好听，所以赵晨临时加了个“郎”
字……“二郎”
就威风多了。

他顿了顿，又接着问道：“为什么说很麻烦？”
“因为任务里提到了‘诡异’，而但凡‘诡异’，一旦成型，至少也需要‘神通’修士才能彻底消灭它。”
祁姓小姑娘面色严肃地回答道。
“诡异？”
赵晨没有掩饰自己的无知，虚心请教道。
在当前情境下，不懂装懂才是大忌。
对此，祁姑娘也没有不耐烦，毕竟相关知识一般人确实接触不到，就算是大派或修行家族子弟，也是到需要外出游历时才会被长辈告知。
而一人计短，二人计长，让这个意外到来的同伴多了解一些没有坏处……就算提不出好建议，也至少能不添乱。
“你听说过‘妖邪’吧？”
祁姑娘反问道。
看着她头上因走路而一甩一甩的翠绿丝带，赵晨点头道：“知道一些……师傅说最弱的妖邪都有神通层次，还说以我现在的实力不该了解太多。”
content_en:
Should I tell the truth, or use words to trick the little girl in front of me and dig out more information?
After weighing it for a few seconds, Zhao Chen decided to choose the former. After all, this place was full of dangers. If his words misled the obviously more experienced girl, it would probably lead to greater disasters and cause the mission to fail.
Although Zhao Chen is keen on taking risks, he is not a reckless man who does not cherish his own life. Naturally, he understands that in the current environment, only sincere cooperation with the little girl will be more conducive to solving the problem.
And openness and honesty are the prerequisite for cooperation.
"Of course, the more important thing is that this girl took the initiative to tell me the information she had before asking me for information. She is obviously very arrogant in dealing with people. If I trick her and deceive her, once I am found out, she will definitely be unhappy...
“For such a character, it’s best to show sincerity.
"Tsk, as a half-traveling businessman, it is also a necessary quality to "talk to people and talk to ghosts".
With his mind spinning, Zhao Chen simply saw himself seeing the "Guanyin Picture"
, and then talked about the process of being inexplicably sent here, but there was no mention of the "Great Sun Star"
, only saying that he used some means to read the memory of demon Taoist Fang Xuzi.
Finally, he spread his hands and said, "So, I don't know what my identity is in this scene."
"So that's how you came in..."
The pretty girl nodded thoughtfully, as if she wanted to ask something else, but soon her tone switched to a slightly impatient state, "Forget it, let's wait until we get out alive, this mission may be very troublesome.
"My surname is Qi. I won't tell you my specific name. What do you call me, sir?" "
His speech is very coherent, and there are no obvious gaps in his thinking logic. It's just that his speech will change into different styles depending on his emotions. It doesn't look like two personalities... But I can't say what the specific situation is...
While thinking in his mind, Zhao Chen also responded: "My surname is Zhao, and I am the second oldest child. Just call me Zhao Er... Lang. "
"Zhao Er"
It sounded too much like a second-hand role, and it didn't sound good, so Zhao Chen temporarily added a "lang"
The word..."Erlang"
It's much more majestic.
He paused and then asked: "Why do you say it's troublesome? "
“Because the mission mentions ‘weirdness’, and once ‘weirdness’ takes shape, at least a ‘supernatural’ monk is needed to completely eliminate it. "
The little girl surnamed Qi replied seriously.
"Weird? "
Zhao Chen did not hide his ignorance and asked for advice humbly.
In the current situation, pretending to understand something you don’t know is a taboo.
In this regard, Miss Qi is not impatient. After all, the relevant knowledge is indeed out of reach of ordinary people. Even the children of large sects or cultivating families will only be informed by their elders when they need to travel.
And one person can be a wise man, and two men can be a wise man. There is no harm in letting this unexpected companion know more about him... Even if he can't make good suggestions, at least he can avoid causing trouble.
“You’ve heard of ‘demon evil’, right? "
Miss Qi asked back.
Looking at the emerald green ribbon on her head that was swaying as she walked, Zhao Chen nodded and said: "I know something... The master said that the weakest monsters all have magical powers, and he also said that with my current strength, I shouldn't know too much. "
